label: kizuna_ecology_d_02
text: I see you’ve already registered 200 species of\nPokémon to your Pokédex for me![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_d_03
text: Wow! Pokémon from the mountains! Pokémon\nfrom the sea! Wait, what?! No way!\r\nYou even found Pokémon in a place like this?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_d_04
text: Ah...sorry about that. I got a little excited there.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_d_05
text: My Pokémon research is moving along\nsuper-duper splendidly thanks to you![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_d_06
text: Here, take this. Consider it my way of saying\nthanks.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_d_07
text: You’re a bona fide Pokémon catching\nprofessional, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_d_08
text: For your next goal, it’s finally time to go for a\ncompleted Pokédex! Aim for 400 species![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_d_09
text: This is no easy feat, but I’m sure you can do it.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_d_10
text: Keep tossing those Poké Balls, and don’t give up![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
